content.title: PCA (PKG) Q2 2025 Earnings Call Transcript
content.summary: Good morning, everyone, and thank you all for participating in Packaging Corporation of America's Second Quarter 2025 Earnings Release Conference Call today.  Yesterday, we reported second quarter net income of $242 million or $2.67 per share.  Excluding the special items, second quarter 2025 net income was $224 million or $2.48 per share compared to the second quarter of 2024 net income of $199 million or $2.20 per share.
